# MagicHack

> Growth consultancy that fuses marketing, data and technology into a single
> operating system. We work with ambitious businesses across the United States,
> Colombia, Bolivia and Panama.

MagicHack Consulting engineers growth instead of advising on it. Engagements
combine strategy, hands-on execution and continuous measurement. Most run 90 to
180 days, with measurable progress inside the first month.

## Services

- [Growth Marketing](https://www.themagichack.com/growth-marketing.html): systematic experimentation across channels. Funnel teardown, ranked experiment backlog, channel scorecard, referral and loop mechanics.
- [Business Intelligence](https://www.themagichack.com/business-intelligence.html): CRM, accounting, operations and marketing unified into one command center with live KPIs and threshold alerts.
- [AI & Automation](https://www.themagichack.com/ai-automation.html): lead capture, segmentation, behaviour-triggered nurture, AI follow-up and appointment setting wired into one pipeline.
- [Contact Center](https://www.themagichack.com/contact-center.html): CRM workflow rebuilt around the conversation, churn signals wired to alerts, agents coached on their own calls.

## Proof

- 340% revenue growth in eighteen months — One Stop Design & Build
- 52% churn reduction in ninety days — Agua Siembra contact center
- 45% market share captured in its segment — JP Resin
- [Movik](https://movik-growth-loop.vercel.app/): FMCSA intelligence wired into a growth operating system
